subject: Intro / Evidence & customer conversations for Aurea Biotherapeutics (late-stage POC)
body:
From: Sara Morris <sara.morris@aureabio.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence-sharing + customer calls for Aurea POC

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Mark and I were impressed with the latency and the model guardrails you showed. We’re moving into a late-stage proof-of-concept for a clinical triage workflow and need two things before procurement: a short reference call with a healthcare customer using Redwood in a regulated clinical setting, and any case study or summary that highlights redwood’s audit log and private deployment features.

Timeline is tight: pilot kickoff in two weeks, procurement review this Friday. Can you share who you can connect us with and availability for 20–30 minute reference calls? Prefer EU-based peers if possible.

Thanks,
Sara Morris
Head of ML Ops (Aurea Biotherapeutics)
sara.morris@aureabio.com
+44 20 7946 0958

--- Forwarded message ---
From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Evidence-sharing + customer calls for Aurea POC

Ben/Marissa — FYI, Aurea (late-stage biotech) wants EU peers who can speak specifically to: private deployment, audit logs/KMS, and successful clinical/regulated pilot outcomes. Procurement needs calls by Friday. I pulled a short summary (attached) and a shortlist.

Quick asks:
- Ben: who is available and comfortable with a short reference call this week? Prefer clinician-facing workflows or regulated POC examples.
- Marissa: can you confirm any customer case study we can share that highlights KMS/HSM integration and SOC2+HIPAA controls (redacted)?

I’ll handle scheduling with Sara after you confirm names.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Aurea_RFP_Summary.pdf (pdf, 420KB), redwood-customer-profiles-shortlist.xlsx (xlsx, 110KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 11:30:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence-sharing + customer calls for Aurea POC

Kimberly,

We have two customers who map well:
1) MedCura (Germany) — ran a 6-week regulated pilot for symptom triage with a private deployment (VPC + HSM). CTO Jens Holst is happy to share a 20–30 minute call; they can speak to audit logs, compliance controls, and how Redwood integrated with their KMS.
2) HelixCare (UK) — used Redwood Dedicated for clinical summarization in a pilot; CS lead can comment on latency, batching, and clinician acceptance.

Availability: MedCura can do Thu Aug 5 (09:00–11:00 BST). HelixCare can do Fri Aug 6 (14:00–16:00 BST). Both calls could be 20 minutes.

I’ll draft a quick mutual action plan we can send to Sara when you’d like.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 617-555-0147

Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence-sharing + customer calls for Aurea POC

Adding a quick note — MedCura has previously signed an NDA that allows brief reference calls for product fit (we keep the conversation at a high level). Jens (CTO) prefers morning CET. I’ll ping Jens now to confirm availability and share the short case summary (I produced a one-pager for audited deployments last quarter).

Marissa

marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 347-555-0223

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:10:28 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence-sharing + customer calls for Aurea POC

Sara / Mark — thanks for the quick turnaround. We can offer the following 20–30 minute reference slots (EU times):
- MedCura (Jens Holst, CTO) — Thu Aug 5, 10:00 BST (20 min) — can cover private deployment, KMS integration, audit logs.
- HelixCare (CS lead) — Fri Aug 6, 14:30 BST (20 min) — can cover latency, batching, clinician workflow fit.

I’ve attached a short RFP summary and a shortlist of customer profiles for your procurement review. Marissa will join the MedCura call and can provide the one-pager that documents controls and redaction approach.

Would you like me to book MedCura now (they’re tight on morning slots) and tentatively hold HelixCare? If yes, what time zone should I send the calendar invites in?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
